[EN] Mission Orders

Eliminate all the enemies in the Cavern of Hunger and Cavern of Slaughter and collect proof of cannibalism.

Likely cannibals include {@LinkCreature:8#3011#gula mutilator}, {@LinkCreature:8#3022#slavering auric imps}, {@LinkCreature:8#3031#gula ravagers}, {@LinkCreature:8#3041#gula overseers}, {@LinkCreature:8#3042#kobold thugs}, and {@LinkCreature:8#3051#kobold hirelings}.

Report to Rameria in Castanica when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Elimina a todos los enemigos en los Cavern of Hunger y Cavern of Slaughter y recolecta pruebas de canibalismo.

Los probables caníbales incluyen al {@LinkCreature:8#3011#gula mutilator}, a los {@LinkCreature:8#3022#slavering auric imps}, a los {@LinkCreature:8#3031#gula ravagers}, a los {@LinkCreature:8#3041#gula overseers}, a los {@LinkCreature:8#3042#kobold thugs} y a los {@LinkCreature:8#3051#kobold hirelings}.

Preséntate ante Rameria en Castanica cuando la misión haya terminado.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
